arxiv-2009-02365.title: LFGCN: Levitating over Graphs with Levy Flights
arxiv-2009-02365.creator: Yuzhou Chen, Yulia R. Gel, Konstantin Avrachenkov
arxiv-2009-02365.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Yuzhou Chen, Yulia R. Gel, Konstantin Avrachenkov. Due to high utility in many applications, from social networks to blockchain to power grids, deep learning on non-Euclidean objects such as graphs and manifolds, coined Geometric Deep Learning (GDL), continues to gain an ever increasing interest.

arxiv-2106-00534.title: DeepWalk: Omnidirectional Bipedal Gait by Deep Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2106-00534.creator: Diego Rodriguez, Sven Behnke
arxiv-2106-00534.description: Abstract Bipedal walking is one of the most difficult but exciting challenges in robotics. The difficulties arise from the complexity of high-dimensional dynamics, sensing and actuation limitations combined with real-time and computational constraints. Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) holds the promise to address these issues by fully exploiting the robot dynamics with minimal craftsmanship.

arxiv-2205-00185.title: Protecting the Integrity of IoT Sensor Data and Firmware With A Feather-Light Blockchain Infrastructure PubID: pubid: 978-1-6654-9538-7/22/$31.00 ©2022 IEEE
arxiv-2205-00185.creator: Daniël Reijsbergen, Aung Maw, Sarad Venugopalan, Dianshi Yang, Tien Tuan Anh Dinh, and Jianying Zhou
arxiv-2205-00185.description: Abstract Smart cities deploy large numbers of sensors and collect a tremendous amount of data from them. For example, Advanced Metering Infrastructures (AMIs), which consist of physical meters that collect usage data about public utilities such as power and water, are an important building block in a smart city.

arxiv-2312-04409.title: Tuning magnetic interactions of Co and 4 d d transition-metal atomic bilayers on Re(0001) via interface engineering
arxiv-2312-04409.creator: Souvik Paul, Stefan Heinze
arxiv-2312-04409.description: Abstract Employing ab-initio density functional theory (DFT), we performed a systematic investigation of the electronic structures and the magnetic properties of atomic bilayers composed of a 4 d d transition-metal layer (Rh, Pd and Ru) and a Co layer on the Re(0001) surface.

arxiv-2410-12933.title: Failed supernova explosions increase the duration of star formation in globular clusters
arxiv-2410-12933.creator: Henriette Wirth 1, Jaroslav Haas 1, Ladislav Šubr 1, Tereza Jerabkova 2, Zhiqiang Yan 3 and Pavel Kroupa 1,4
arxiv-2410-12933.description: Abstract Context. The duration of star formation (SF)in globular clusters (GCs)is an essential aspect for understanding their formation. Contrary to previous presumptions that all stars above 8 M ⊙ M_{\odot} explode as core-collapse supernovae (CCSNe), recent evidence suggests a more complex scenario. Aims.

arxiv-2503-06241.title: A Noise-Robust Turn-Taking System for Real-World Dialogue Robots: A Field Experiment
arxiv-2503-06241.creator: Koji Inoue, Yuki Okafuji, Jun Baba, Yoshiki Ohira, Katsuya Hyodo, Tatsuya Kawahara
arxiv-2503-06241.description: Abstract Turn-taking is a crucial aspect of human-robot interaction, directly influencing conversational fluidity and user engagement. While previous research has explored turn-taking models in controlled environments, their robustness in real-world settings remains underexplored. In this study, we propose a noise-robust voice activity projection (VAP) model, based on a Transformer architecture, to enhance real-time turn-taking in dialogue robots.

Rougeole), an acute infectious disease occurring mostly in children. It is mentioned in the writings of Rhazes and others of the Arabian physicians in the 10th century. For long, however, it was held to be a variety of small-pox.

pmc-11447119.title: Nonlocal photonic quantum gates over 7.0 km
pmc-11447119.creator: Xiao Liu, Xiao-Min Hu, Tian-Xiang Zhu, Chao Zhang, Yi-Xin Xiao, Jia-Le Miao, Zhong-Wen Ou, Pei-Yun Li, Bi-Heng Liu, Zong-Quan Zhou, Chuan-Feng Li, Guang-Can Guo
pmc-11447119.description: Quantum networks provide a prospective paradigm to connect separated quantum nodes, which relies on the distribution of long-distance entanglement and active feedforward control of qubits between remote nodes. Such approaches can be utilized to construct nonlocal quantum gates, forming building blocks for distributed quantum computing and other novel quantum applications.

pmc-11463258.title: The massive 2016 marine heatwave in the Southwest Pacific: An “El Niño–Madden-Julian Oscillation” compound event
pmc-11463258.creator: Cyril Dutheil, Shilpa Lal, Matthieu Lengaigne, Sophie Cravatte, Christophe Menkès, Aurore Receveur, Florian Börgel, Matthias Gröger, Fanny Houlbreque, Romain Le Gendre, Inès Mangolte, Alexandre Peltier, H. E. Markus Meier
pmc-11463258.description: El Niño typically induces cooling in the Southwest Pacific Ocean during austral summers, usually leading to decreased marine heatwave frequency and severity. However, the 2016 extreme El Niño unexpectedly coincided with the longest and most extensive marine heatwave ever recorded in the region. This heatwave, spanning over 1.

pmc-11536439.title: Mannose-6-Phosphate Isomerase Functional Status Shapes a Rearrangement in the Proteome and Degradome of Mannose-Treated Melanoma Cells
pmc-11536439.creator: Nathália de Vasconcellos Racorti, Matheus Martinelli, Silvina Odete Bustos, Murilo Salardani, Maurício Frota Camacho, Uilla Barcick, Luis Roberto Fonseca Lima, Letícia Dias Lima Jedlicka, Claudia Barbosa Ladeira de Campos, Richard Hemmi Valente, Roger Chammas, André Zelanis
pmc-11536439.description: Metabolic reprogramming is a ubiquitous feature of transformed cells, comprising one of the hallmarks of cancer and enabling neoplastic cells to adapt to new environments. Accumulated evidence reports on the failure of some neoplastic cells to convert mannose-6-phosphate into fructose-6-phosphate, thereby impairing tumor growth in cells displaying low levels of mannose-6-phosphate isomerase (MPI).

pmc-11608905.title: Comparison of 3D facial photographs and clinical documentation in patients with craniofacial morphea
pmc-11608905.creator: Tyler T Nguyen, Stephanie M Cohen, Katharina S Shaw, Fatma Dedeoglu, Ruth Ann Vleugels, Ingrid M Ganske
pmc-11608905.description: Diagnosis of craniofacial morphea (CM) relies upon clinical examination of progressive craniofacial changes. We assess the utility of 3D stereophotogrammetry in documenting asymmetry of the face compared to clinical notetaking. This retrospective study of 3D images and clinical documentation included 32 patients (mean age 15.7 years) with CM.

pmc-11690113.title: MAJOR STUDY FINDINGS ON THE ASSOCIATION BETWEEN MEDICAID PAYMENTS AND COSTS
pmc-11690113.creator: Edward Miller, Marc Cohen, Elizabeth Simpson, Sara Karon, Iara Oliveira, Judith Dey, Marie Squillace, John Bowblis
pmc-11690113.description: In 2019, Medicaid payment rates covered about 82 cents per dollar of estimated nursing home (NH) reported Medicaid costs. Roughly 40% of NHs had Medicaid payments covering 80% or less of their reported costs; 51% of NHs had 80-100% of their reported Medicaid costs covered; 8% of NHs had payments exceeding reported costs.

pmc-12734256.title: Genetic Spectrum, Clinical Characteristics, and Molecular Pathogenesis of Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy Requiring Heart Transplantation
pmc-12734256.creator: Sofiya Andreeva, Lyubov Korneva, Mariya Marusova, Yulia Sazonova, Alexandra Gudkova, Anna Streltsova, Svetlana Fetisova, Maria Simonenko, Anna Fanta, Andrei Semenov, Maria Bortsova, Lubov Mitrofanova, Olga Moiseeva, Alexandr Bobylev, Lidiya Gavrilova, Ivan Vikhlyantsev, Petr Fedotov, Anna Kostareva,
pmc-12734256.description: Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) progressing to end-stage heart failure and heart transplantation (HT) is a rare clinical scenario with an insufficiently explored genetic background. In this single-center retrospective cohort study, we aimed to characterize the genetic spectrum, variants of HCM adverse remodeling, and aspects of molecular pathogenesis of this subgroup.

pmc-13254281.title: Early life exposure to N-nitrosamine drives genotoxicity, mutagenesis, and tumorigenesis in DNA repair-deficient mice
pmc-13254281.creator: Lindsay B. Volk, Monét Norales, Callie Karjane, Joshua J. Corrigan, Alper J. Alcaraz, Lee J. Pribyl, Nicolette A. Bugher, Megan Blawas, Isabella Dulski, Einthavy Arunachalam, Nina Gubina, Emily Michelsen, Kannammai Pichappan, Natalya Yakimchuk, Matilda Swanson, Duanduan Ma, Stuart S. Levine, Desiree
pmc-13254281.description: N-Nitrosodimethylamine (NDMA) is a probable human carcinogen found in contaminated pharmaceuticals and drinking water, yet the impact of age on NDMA susceptibility remains poorly understood. Using DNA repair-deficient (Aag-/-;Mgmt-/-) and wild-type mice, we systematically compare the effects of NDMA exposure in juveniles and adults.

pmc-13522274.title: Semantic Knowledge Guided Diffusion Model for Biomedical Ontology Definition Generation
pmc-13522274.creator: Shailesh Dahal, Ratri Mukherjee, Nicholas Mathews, Bijaya Adhikari, Kishlay Jha
pmc-13522274.description: Biomedical ontologies such as the Unified Medical Language System (UMLS) play a crucial role in supporting practical applications such as predicting gene–disease associations, drug–drug interactions, and biomedical question answering. However, automatically maintaining and updating them remains a critical barrier as authoring high-quality textual definitions is both time-consuming and labor-intensive.
